originality.rationale: The previously accessible claims certify only nonequivariant sphere multiplicities for these fourth-robust grids; their homotopy types do not force any nontrivial group action. Filakovsky (arXiv:2602.11365) proves fourth-robust edge-gluing families only and frames corner-gluing as an open extension. The closest published grid equivariant representation statements concern third-robust homology, not the fourth-robust negative reflection traces. Four targeted database queries and exact textual literature comparisons found no equivalent full rational character theorem for these four grids; this is a best-knowledge assessment, not an absolute novelty proof.
residual_risks: Related unpublished or unindexed equivariant finite computations might already determine these fourth-robust rational modules.
The claim is proved for four finite grids, not an infinite family; no equivalence is asserted at the integral module or equivariant homotopy level.

value.rationale: The motivating recent work leaves higher-robust corner-gluing cases unresolved. Although the scalar homotopy ranks of several grids are already known, no scalar rank determines the reflection signs: the fourth-robust square character contains negative traces and is a planar orientation twist of the square-triple permutation module. This gives all small rectangular symmetry classes and determines the nontrivial 6-dimensional invariant degree-five quotient homology for the 4x4 square.
